metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic close-up of a stack of fluffy pancakes on a ceramic plate. A rectangular pat of butter sits on top, partially melted into a glossy golden liquid pool that drips down the sides. Gentle steam rises from the warm stack. Soft morning light, high texture detail, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: Warm pancakes naturally transfer heat to butter, causing it to melt into a liquid pool while emitting gentle steam.
